name: Printsessa Nesmeyana
source:
"Loneliness is neither a gift nor a curse."

This is a story of an extraordinary button capable of erasing every living thing from the camp for the duration of the current cycle.
About the endless cycle of things people do not know how to, and cannot, say or express...
About how the cyclical nature of things erases all boundaries of reality, and...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2939413183]Steam[/url]]
